summary: Iteration 70 - Bank Detail View (Visor 360°) and Bank Integrations Feature - All backend (16/16) and frontend tests passed. The feature implements a 360° view of banks with 3 sections: VPOS/MPOS active products, PG/Link active products, and Integration Roadmap. Full CRUD for bank integrations with 6-step status flow (Negoc. → DESA → SQA → Imple. → PreProd → Completado) working correctly.

issues: Console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' - React hydration error (non-blocking, from Emergent injection)

seed_data_creation: Test integration created and deleted during testing on Banco de Venezuela (bnk_3997d471d939)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bank Visor 360° feature verified. Key data: Banco de Venezuela (bnk_3997d471d939) has 5 products (3 VPOS/MPOS, 2 PG/Link) and 1 test integration (TDD/TDC Test in DESA status). The route is /banks/:bankId. Integration statuses are: Negoc., DESA, SQA, Imple., PreProd, Completado. Bank list shows counters 'X Activos' (green) and 'Y en Integración' (purple with rocket icon). Eye button and bank name click both navigate to detail page.
